lena-security: Quick check — we're prepping evidence handoff for SOC2 CC6 tomorrow. Need a clear sequence for RBAC change proofs + KMS rotation + vuln triage artifacts. Who will own the signing manifest? cc @sam

sam: I can own RBAC change proofs. I'll link PRs, k8s audit log slices, and rolebinding snapshots. Will include commit SHAs + PR numbers.

maria: For KMS rotation, we can provide rotation audit entries and key metadata export. Example path: s3://redwood-evidence/kms-rotation/2025-06-05/ (kms_export_20250605.json.gz).

jon-ops: Vuln triage will include ticket list, severity matrix, patch PRs, and scanner exports. Also a short exec summary for each finding (impact + mitigation).

auditor-bot: Note: auditors will request chain-of-custody + file hashes (sha256). Please include checksums in the manifest and a brief method to reproduce exports.

lena-security: Sounds good. Can someone paste the CLI commands we used to pull logs so the auditors can reproduce? They specifically asked for reproducible steps.

sam: ```bash
# slice k8s audit logs for rolebinding changes
aws s3 cp s3://redwood-logs/k8s-audit/20250605.ndjson - | jq -c 'select(.verb=="create" or .verb=="patch")' > rbac_slice.ndjson
```

maria: ```bash
# export KMS key metadata and rotation events
gcloud kms keys describe projects/redwood/locations/global/keyRings/prod/cryptoKeys/serving-key --format=json > kms_meta.json
# copy rotation audit bundle
gsutil cp gs://redwood-evidence/kms-rotation/20250605/kms_export_20250605.json.gz .
```

jon-ops: ```bash
# vuln scanner export (example)
gh api -H "Accept: application/vnd.github.v3+json" /repos/redwood/infra/issues?labels=vulnerability > vuln_list.json
```

eve-se: I'll assemble manifest.yaml containing: file name, sha256, owner, extraction command, timestamp, and a short proof description. We should sign it with KMS-based HSM signing (preferred) — auditors like a KMS-signed proof over PGP here.

lena-security: HSM/KMS signing preferred. @eve-se can you deliver by 16:00? Also need PR links + screenshots of the access log that shows who applied the rolebinding change. :eyes: 

eve-se: Yes, aiming for 15:30. I'll add a one-paragraph narrative for each artifact describing why it satisfies the control and include signer id + key id.

auditor-bot: Field request: include the exact query used to extract audit log entries (time window and selectors).

sam: Sample jq filter I used: ```bash
jq -c 'select(.verb=="create" and .objectRef.resource=="rolebindings")' rbac_slice.ndjson > rb_changes.json
```

maria: I'll attach a truncated CloudKMS rotation audit snippet (PII scrubbed) plus the rotation-event ID and timestamp.

lena-security: Perfect. Last ask: manifest must include signer name, key id, and UTC timestamp for chain-of-custody. I'll package and run a quick spot-check before handoff. Thanks all.
